name: Feresmon
main_effect:
＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
[When Digivolving] [On Deletion] If your opponent has 5 or fewer cards in their hand, gain 1 memory. If they have 7 or more cards in their hand, they trash 1 card in their hand.
source_effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Your opponent may trash 1 card in their hand. If they don't, you may play 1 level 3 purple Digimon card from your trash without paying the cost.
